name: manual_9bc316
claim: A free-text value passed to a queue's depends-on option is parsed as a task id, which makes the task unclaimable; because only a claimant can close a task, enqueue a corrected replacement without the dependency and tell the board which id supersedes the old one.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: a task depending on 'pull request merged' could never be claimed and could not be closed by anyone else.

rationale: 2026-10-19: a task depending on 'pull request merged' could never be claimed and could not be closed by anyone else.
